properties.description: Eight tests through call_tool by tool name (failed 8/8 on origin/main 6329079 before the fix) and seven core tests: addressee and number recorded; unknown addressee, evidence, answerer or record refused with nothing written; ANSWERS drawn in the same call; a later answer naming nobody does not inherit the last answerer; open_questions(asked_of) returns the batch in order with evidence links and says what it left out; an unaddressed question reads asked_of null; loop_status(contributor_id) lists questions_put_to_them; an answer through an agent records answered_via and ACTS_FOR.
properties.name: A question is put to a named person as a numbered batch with evidence links, and one answer_question call records the answerer and draws ANSWERS
